gloss: on the occasion of; when; at the time of

definitions.gloss: on the occasion of; when; at the time of
definitions.explanation: A formal expression used to mark a significant occasion or important moment as the context for what follows. Attaches to nouns or verb dictionary forms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧にあたって、⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}します→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: On the occasion of graduation, I would like to say a few words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めるにあたって、⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: In starting the new project, preparation is necessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開会|かいかい}→開会：04118_kaikai⟧にあたって、⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ご{挨拶|あいさつ}→ご挨拶：23538_goaisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: On the occasion of the opening, the chairperson will offer greetings to everyone.

notes:
A formal compound particle meaning "on the occasion of" or "when undertaking." Derived from the verb ⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to correspond to / to face). Used in speeches, formal writing, and business contexts to frame an important event or action.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun + にあたって: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧にあたって (on the occasion of graduation)
- Verb dictionary form + にあたって: {始|はじ}めるにあたって (when starting)
- ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたり is a slightly more formal variant used in the same way

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧にあたって: on the occasion of holding (an event)
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧にあたって: upon departure
- ⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧にあたって: upon taking office
- ⟦{実施|じっし}→実施：03275_jisshi⟧にあたって: in carrying out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦に{際|さい}して→に際して：06945_nisaishite⟧: on the occasion of — very similar meaning, slightly more formal and written
- ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたり: variant form of にあたって — interchangeable in most contexts
- {時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: when — neutral and general; にあたって adds formality and weight to the occasion
